data.name: Combat Trick / Greater Trip
data.description: You can select this feat even if you don't meet the ability score prerequisite (Intelligence 13). You gain the benefits of this feat only as long as you have at least 1 stamina point in your stamina pool. You can spend 2 stamina points after you successfully trip an opponent to deal 1d6 points of falling damage to the target.
